claims.formal_statement:
import Mathlib

open Finset

noncomputable section

namespace AdaptiveAccounting

variable {S X Z Y Key Ω : Type*}
variable [Fintype S] [Fintype X] [Fintype Z] [Fintype Y] [Fintype Ω]

def flag (p : Prop) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if p then 1 else 0

theorem flag_nonneg (p : Prop) : 0 ≤ flag p := by
  classical
  by_cases h : p <;> simp [flag, h]

def energy (mask : Y → Prop) (a c : Y → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ y, flag (mask y) * |a y - c y| ^ 8

theorem energy_nonneg (mask : Y → Prop) (a c : Y → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ energy mask a c := by
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intro y _
  exact mul_nonneg (flag_nonneg _) (by positivity)

theorem unit_port_charge (mask : Y → Prop) (a c : Y → ℝ) (y : Y)
    (hm : mask y) (ha : a y = 1) (hc : c y = 0) :
    1 ≤ energy mask a c := by
  classical
  have h := Finset.single_le_sum
    (fun v (_ : v ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset Y)) =>
      mul_nonneg (flag_nonneg (mask v)) (show 0 ≤ |a v - c v| ^ 8 by positivity))
    (Finset.mem_univ y)
  simpa [energy, flag, hm, ha, hc] using h

def Escaped (direct : X → Y → Prop) (left : X → Z → Prop)
    (right : Z → Y → Prop) (envelope : X → Finset Y) (x : X) : Prop :=
  (∃ y, direct x y ∧ y ∉ envelope x) ∨
    ∃ z y, left x z ∧ right z y ∧ y ∉ envelope x

omit [Fintype X] in
theorem witness_escape_charge
    (direct : X → Y → Prop) (left : X → Z → Prop) (right : Z → Y → Prop)
    (envelope : X → Finset Y)
    (directMask rightMask : Y → Prop) (midMask : Z → Prop)
    (ad cd : X → Y → ℝ) (al cl : X → Z → ℝ) (ar cr : Z → Y → ℝ)
    (hd : ∀ x y, direct x y → ad x y = 1 ∧ directMask y)
    (hl : ∀ x z, left x z → al x z = 1 ∧ midMask z)
    (hr : ∀ z y, right z y → ar z y = 1 ∧ rightMask y)
    (hcd : ∀ x y, cd x y ≠ 0 → y ∈ envelope x)
    (hcr : ∀ x z y, cl x z ≠ 0 → cr z y ≠ 0 → y ∈ envelope x)
    (x : X) :
    flag (Escaped direct left right envelope x) ≤
      energy directMask (ad x) (cd x) + energy midMask (al x) (cl x) +
        ∑ z, flag (left x z) * flag (midMask z) * energy rightMask (ar z) (cr z) := by
  classical
  have hnD := energy_nonneg directMask (ad x) (cd x)
  have hnL := energy_nonneg midMask (al x) (cl x)
  have hnR : 0 ≤ ∑ z,
      flag (left x z) * flag (midMask z) * energy rightMask (ar z) (cr z) := by
    apply Finset.sum_nonneg
    intro z _
    exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (flag_nonneg _) (flag_nonneg _))
      (energy_nonneg _ _ _)
  by_cases hb : Escaped direct left right envelope x
  · rw [show flag (Escaped direct left right envelope x) = 1 by simp [flag, hb]]
    rcases hb with ⟨y, hdy, hy⟩ | ⟨z, y, hlz, hry, hy⟩
    · have hzero : cd x y = 0 := by
        by_contra h
        exact hy (hcd x y h)
      have h := unit_port_charge directMask (ad x) (cd x) y (hd x y hdy).2
        (hd x y hdy).1 hzero
      linarith
    · by_cases hzero : cl x z = 0
      · have h := unit_port_charge midMask (al x) (cl x) z (hl x z hlz).2
          (hl x z hlz).1 hzero
        linarith
      · have hrzero : cr z y = 0 := by
          by_contra h
          exact hy (hcr x z y hzero h)
        have hunit := unit_port_charge rightMask (ar z) (cr z) y (hr z y hry).2
          (hr z y hry).1 hrzero
        have hsum := Finset.single_le_sum
          (fun w (_ : w ∈ (Finset.univ : Finset Z)) =>
            mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (flag_nonneg (left x w)) (flag_nonneg (midMask w)))
              (energy_nonneg rightMask (ar w) (cr w)))
          (Finset.mem_univ z)
        have hmid := (hl x z hlz).2
        have hle : energy rightMask (ar z) (cr z) ≤
            ∑ w, flag (left x w) * flag (midMask w) *
              energy rightMask (ar w) (cr w) := by
          simpa [flag, hlz, hmid] using hsum
        linarith
  · rw [show flag (Escaped direct left right envelope x) = 0 by simp [flag, hb]]
    linarith

theorem capped_transport
    (source : X → Prop) (mid : Z → Prop) (ports : X → Z → Prop)
    (r : Z → ℝ) (cap : ℝ)
    (hr : ∀ z, 0 ≤ r z)
    (hcap : ∀ z, (∑ x, flag (source x) * flag (ports x z)) ≤ cap) :
    (∑ x, flag (source x) *
      ∑ z, flag (ports x z) * flag (mid z) * r z) ≤
      cap * ∑ z, flag (mid z) * r z := by
  classical
  calc
    _ = ∑ z, ∑ x,
        (flag (source x) * flag (ports x z)) * (flag (mid z) * r z) := by
      simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro z _
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro x _
      ring
    _ = ∑ z, (∑ x, flag (source x) * flag (ports x z)) *
        (flag (mid z) * r z) := by simp_rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ ≤ ∑ z, cap * (flag (mid z) * r z) := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro z _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hcap z) (mul_nonneg (flag_nonneg _) (hr z))
    _ = _ := by rw [Finset.mul_sum]

theorem normalized_source_release
    (source : X → Prop) (mid : Z → Prop) (ports : X → Z → Prop)
    (r : Z → ℝ) (cap N u f : ℝ)
    (hr : ∀ z, 0 ≤ r z)
    (hcap : ∀ z, (∑ x, flag (source x) * flag (ports x z)) ≤ cap)
    (hN : 0 < N) (hu : 0 < u) (hf : 0 < f) :
    (∑ x, flag (source x) *
      ∑ z, flag (ports x z) * flag (mid z) * r z) / (N * u) ≤
      cap * (f / u) * ((∑ z, flag (mid z) * r z) / (N * f)) := by
  calc
    _ ≤ (cap * ∑ z, flag (mid z) * r z) / (N * u) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (capped_transport source mid ports r cap hr hcap)
        (le_of_lt (mul_pos hN hu))
    _ = _ := by
      field_simp

theorem precision_pays_reset (ratio e a : ℝ) (hr : 1 ≤ ratio)
    (hprecision : ratio * e ^ 2 ≤ a ^ 2) :
    ratio * e ^ 8 ≤ a ^ 8 := by
  have h2 : 1 ≤ ratio ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ratio - 1)]
  have h12 : ratio ≤ ratio ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ratio - 1)]
  have h24 : ratio ^ 2 ≤ ratio ^ 4 := by
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (ratio ^ 2 - 1)]
  calc
    _ ≤ ratio ^ 4 * e ^ 8 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h12.trans h24) (by positivity)
    _ = (ratio * e ^ 2) ^ 4 := by ring
    _ ≤ (a ^ 2) ^ 4 := by
      gcongr
    _ = _ := by ring

theorem integrate_escape_charge
    (source : X → Prop) (mid : Z → Prop) (ports : X → Z → Prop)
    (bad : X → Prop) (d l : X → ℝ) (r : Z → ℝ) (cap : ℝ)
    (hr : ∀ z, 0 ≤ r z)
    (hcap : ∀ z, (∑ x, flag (source x) * flag (ports x z)) ≤ cap)
    (hcharge : ∀ x, flag (bad x) ≤ d x + l x +
      ∑ z, flag (ports x z) * flag (mid z) * r z) :
    (∑ x, flag (source x) * flag (bad x)) ≤
      (∑ x, flag (source x) * (d x + l x)) +
        cap * ∑ z, flag (mid z) * r z := by
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ x, flag (source x) *
        (d x + l x + ∑ z, flag (ports x z) * flag (mid z) * r z) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun x _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hcharge x) (flag_nonneg _)
    _ = (∑ x, flag (source x) * (d x + l x)) +
        ∑ x, flag (source x) *
          ∑ z, flag (ports x z) * flag (mid z) * r z := by
      simp_rw [mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add le_rfl (capped_transport source mid ports r cap hr hcap)

def Collision (e : Finset Y) (key : Y → Key) : Prop :=
  ∃ v ∈ e, ∃ w ∈ e, v ≠ w ∧ key v = key w

omit [Fintype Y] in
theorem collision_union_indicator (e : Finset Y) (key : Y → Key) :
    flag (Collision e key) ≤
      ∑ v ∈ e, ∑ w ∈ e, flag (v ≠ w ∧ key v = key w) := by
  classical
  by_cases hc : Collision e key
  · rcases hc with ⟨v, hv, w, hw, hne, hkey⟩
    have hinner := Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun z (_ : z ∈ e) => flag_nonneg (v ≠ z ∧ key v = key z)) hw
    have houter := Finset.single_le_sum
      (fun z (_ : z ∈ e) =>
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun t (_ : t ∈ e) => flag_nonneg (z ≠ t ∧ key z = key t))) hv
    have hone : 1 ≤ ∑ z ∈ e, flag (v ≠ z ∧ key v = key z) := by
      simpa [flag, hne, hkey] using hinner
    have hcollision : Collision e key := ⟨v, hv, w, hw, hne, hkey⟩
    simpa [flag, hcollision] using hone.trans houter
  · rw [show flag (Collision e key) = 0 by simp [flag, hc]]
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun v _ =>
      Finset.sum_nonneg fun w _ => flag_nonneg _

omit [Fintype Y] in
theorem fixed_envelope_collision (p : S → ℝ) (e : Finset Y)
    (key : S → Y → Key) (delta : ℝ) (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hd : 0 ≤ delta)
    (hpair : ∀ v w, v ≠ w →
      (∑ s, p s * flag (key s v = key s w)) ≤ delta) :
    (∑ s, p s * flag (Collision e (key s))) ≤ (e.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * delta := by
  classical
  calc
    _ ≤ ∑ s, p s * ∑ v ∈ e, ∑ w ∈ e,
        flag (v ≠ w ∧ key s v = key s w) := by
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun s _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (collision_union_indicator e (key s)) (hp s)
    _ = ∑ v ∈ e, ∑ w ∈ e, ∑ s, p s *
        flag (v ≠ w ∧ key s v = key s w) := by
      simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro v _
      rw [Finset.sum_comm]
    _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ e, ∑ w ∈ e, delta := by
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro v _
      apply Finset.sum_le_sum
      intro w _
      by_cases h : v = w
      · subst w
        simpa [flag] using hd
      · simpa [flag, h] using hpair v w h
    _ = _ := by simp; ring

omit [Fintype Y] in
theorem stable_height_collision (p : S → ℝ) (e : Finset Y)
    (key : S → Y → Key) (delta height : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hd : 0 ≤ delta)
    (hpair : ∀ v w, v ≠ w →
      (∑ s, p s * flag (key s v = key s w)) ≤ delta) :
    (∑ s, p s * flag (Collision e (key s)) * height ^ 8) ≤
      (e.card : ℝ) ^ 2 * delta * height ^ 8 := by
  calc
    _ = (∑ s, p s * flag (Collision e (key s))) * height ^ 8 := by
      rw [Finset.sum_mul]
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (fixed_envelope_collision p e key delta hp hd hpair) (by positivity)

theorem fixed_variant_reindex (variant : Ω ≃ Ω) (integrand : Ω → ℝ) :
    (∑ omega, integrand (variant omega)) = ∑ omega, integrand omega := by
  exact Equiv.sum_comp variant integrand

def bucket (candidates : Finset Y) (representative : Y → Prop)
    (key : Y → Key) (increment : Y → ℝ) (y : Y) : ℝ := by
  classical
  exact if representative y then
    ∑ v ∈ candidates, if key v = key y then increment v else 0
  else 0

omit [Fintype Y] in
theorem bucket_exact_without_collision
    (candidates envelope : Finset Y) (representative : Y → Prop)
    (key : Y → Key) (increment : Y → ℝ)
    (hc : candidates ⊆ envelope)
    (hr : ∀ y, representative y → y ∈ envelope)
    (hcover : ∀ v ∈ candidates, ∃ y, representative y ∧ key y = key v)
    (hsupport : ∀ y, y ∉ candidates → increment y = 0)
    (hinj : ¬ Collision envelope key) (y : Y) :
    bucket candidates representative key increment y = increment y := by
  classical
  have unique : ∀ v ∈ envelope, ∀ w ∈ envelope, key v = key w → v = w := by
    intro v hv w hw heq
    by_contra hne
    exact hinj ⟨v, hv, w, hw, hne, heq⟩
  by_cases hy : representative y
  · rw [bucket, if_pos hy]
    calc
      _ = ∑ v ∈ candidates, if v = y then increment v else 0 := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro v hv
        have heq : key v = key y ↔ v = y :=
          ⟨fun h => unique v (hc hv) y (hr y hy) h, fun h => congrArg key h⟩
        simp only [heq]
      _ = increment y := by
        by_cases hmem : y ∈ candidates
        · simp [hmem]
        · simp [hmem, hsupport y hmem]
  · have hmem : y ∉ candidates := by
      intro h
      obtain ⟨w, hw, heq⟩ := hcover y h
      have hwy := unique w (hr w hw) y (hc h) heq
      exact hy (hwy ▸ hw)
    simp [bucket, hy, hsupport y hmem]

omit [Fintype Y] in
theorem bucket_magnitude
    (candidates : Finset Y) (representative : Y → Prop) (key : Y → Key)
    (increment : Y → ℝ) (bound : ℝ) (hb : 0 ≤ bound)
    (hi : ∀ y, |increment y| ≤ bound) (y : Y) :
    |bucket candidates representative key increment y| ≤
      (candidates.card : ℝ) * bound := by
  classical
  by_cases hy : representative y
  · rw [bucket, if_pos hy]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ v ∈ candidates, |if key v = key y then increment v else 0| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ ≤ ∑ _v ∈ candidates, bound := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro v _
        by_cases h : key v = key y
        · simpa [h] using hi v
        · simpa [h] using hb
      _ = _ := by simp
  · simp [bucket, hy]
    positivity

omit [Fintype Y] in
theorem only_increments_aliased
    (candidates envelope : Finset Y) (representative : Y → Prop)
    (key : Y → Key) (actual clean : Y → ℝ) (error height : ℝ)
    (he : 0 ≤ error) (hh : 0 ≤ height)
    (hdiff : ∀ y, |actual y - clean y| ≤ error)
    (hheight : ∀ y, |clean y| ≤ height)
    (hc : candidates ⊆ envelope)
    (hr : ∀ y, representative y → y ∈ envelope)
    (hcover : ∀ v ∈ candidates, ∃ y, representative y ∧ key y = key v)
    (hsupport : ∀ y, y ∉ candidates → actual y = 0)
    (oldActual oldClean : Y → ℝ) (y : Y) :
    |(oldActual y + bucket candidates representative key actual y) -
        (oldClean y + clean y)| ≤
      |oldActual y - oldClean y| +
        ((candidates.card : ℝ) + 1) *
          (error + flag (Collision envelope key) * height) := by
  classical
  have hinc : |bucket candidates representative key actual y - clean y| ≤
      ((candidates.card : ℝ) + 1) *
        (error + flag (Collision envelope key) * height) := by
    by_cases hcollision : Collision envelope key
    · have ha : ∀ v, |actual v| ≤ error + height := by
        intro v
        calc
          _ = |(actual v - clean v) + clean v| := by ring_nf
          _ ≤ |actual v - clean v| + |clean v| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ ≤ _ := add_le_add (hdiff v) (hheight v)
      have hb := bucket_magnitude candidates representative key actual (error + height)
        (add_nonneg he hh) ha y
      have ht := abs_sub (bucket candidates representative key actual y) (clean y)
      have hcard : 0 ≤ (candidates.card : ℝ) := by positivity
      simp only [flag, if_pos hcollision, one_mul]
      nlinarith [hheight y]
    · rw [bucket_exact_without_collision candidates envelope representative key actual
        hc hr hcover hsupport hcollision y]
      simp only [flag, if_neg hcollision, zero_mul, add_zero]
      have hcard : 0 ≤ (candidates.card : ℝ) := by positivity
      nlinarith [hdiff y, mul_nonneg hcard he]
  calc
    _ = |(oldActual y - oldClean y) +
        (bucket candidates representative key actual y - clean y)| := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ |oldActual y - oldClean y| +
        |bucket candidates representative key actual y - clean y| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add le_rfl hinc

def weightedSum (p : S → ℝ) (f : S → ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ s, p s * f s

theorem weightedSum_add (p f g : S → ℝ) :
    weightedSum p (fun s => f s + g s) = weightedSum p f + weightedSum p g := by
  simp [weightedSum, mul_add, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

theorem weightedSum_scale (p f : S → ℝ) (a : ℝ) :
    weightedSum p (fun s => a * f s) = a * weightedSum p f := by
  unfold weightedSum
  rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro s _
  ring

theorem weightedSum_mono (p f g : S → ℝ) (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s)
    (hfg : ∀ s, f s ≤ g s) : weightedSum p f ≤ weightedSum p g := by
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun s _ => mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hfg s) (hp s)

theorem weightedSum_sum (p : S → ℝ) (f : S → X → ℝ) :
    weightedSum p (fun s => ∑ x, f s x) =
      ∑ x, weightedSum p (fun s => f s x) := by
  unfold weightedSum
  simp_rw [Finset.mul_sum]
  exact Finset.sum_comm

omit [Fintype Y] in
theorem adaptive_accounting
    (p : S → ℝ) (source : X → Prop) (bad : S → X → Prop)
    (envelope : X → Finset Y) (key : S → Y → Key)
    (height : X → ℝ) (loss numeric : S → X → ℝ)
    (escapeBudget : S → ℝ) (failureBound delta : ℝ)
    (hp : ∀ s, 0 ≤ p s) (hf : 0 ≤ failureBound) (hd : 0 ≤ delta)
    (hpair : ∀ v w, v ≠ w →
      (∑ s, p s * flag (key s v = key s w)) ≤ delta)
    (hescape : ∀ s, (∑ x, flag (source x) * flag (bad s x)) ≤ escapeBudget s)
    (hloss : ∀ s x, loss s x ≤ failureBound * flag (bad s x) + numeric s x +
      flag (Collision (envelope x) (key s)) * height x ^ 8) :
    weightedSum p (fun s => ∑ x, flag (source x) * loss s x) ≤
      failureBound * weightedSum p escapeBudget +
        weightedSum p (fun s => ∑ x, flag (source x) * numeric s x) +
        delta * ∑ x, flag (source x) * ((envelope x).card : ℝ) ^ 2 * height x ^ 8 := by
  classical
  have hpoint : ∀ s, (∑ x, flag (source x) * loss s x) ≤
      failureBound * escapeBudget s +
        (∑ x, flag (source x) * numeric s x) +
        ∑ x, flag (source x) *
          (flag (Collision (envelope x) (key s)) * height x ^ 8) := by
    intro s
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ x, (failureBound * (flag (source x) * flag (bad s x)) +
          flag (source x) * numeric s x +
          flag (source x) * (flag (Collision (envelope x) (key s)) * height x ^ 8)) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro x _
        calc
          _ ≤ flag (source x) *
              (failureBound * flag (bad s x) + numeric s x +
                flag (Collision (envelope x) (key s)) * height x ^ 8) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hloss s x) (flag_nonneg _)
          _ = _ := by ring
      _ = failureBound * (∑ x, flag (source x) * flag (bad s x)) +
          (∑ x, flag (source x) * numeric s x) +
          ∑ x, flag (source x) *
            (flag (Collision (envelope x) (key s)) * height x ^ 8) := by
        simp_rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.mul_sum]
      _ ≤ _ := add_le_add
        (add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hescape s) hf) le_rfl) le_rfl
  have hcollision :
      weightedSum p (fun s => ∑ x, flag (source x) *
        (flag (Collision (envelope x) (key s)) * height x ^ 8)) ≤
      delta * ∑ x, flag (source x) * ((envelope x).card : ℝ) ^ 2 * height x ^ 8 := by
    rw [weightedSum_sum]
    simp_rw [weightedSum_scale]
    calc
      _ ≤ ∑ x, flag (source x) *
          (((envelope x).card : ℝ) ^ 2 * delta * height x ^ 8) := by
        apply Finset.sum_le_sum
        intro x _
        apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left _ (flag_nonneg _)
        simpa [weightedSum, mul_assoc] using
          stable_height_collision p (envelope x) key delta (height x) hp hd hpair
      _ = _ := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro x _
        ring
  have h := weightedSum_mono p _ _ hp hpoint
  simp only [weightedSum_add, weightedSum_scale] at h
  linarith
